purpose: Three-view orthographic render establishing the canonical form anchor for the elderly AI companion device — organic pebble shape with screen, breathing light ring, and fabric mesh zone
prompt:
Three-view orthographic technical presentation of an AI companion device for elderly users. Clean product design sheet on warm neutral background (#E8E4DF).

FRONT VIEW (left): Organic pebble-shaped device, height-to-width ratio ~1:1.3. Upper 1/3 features a horizontal elliptical screen with soft amber breathing light ring (#E8C9A0) around it. Lower 2/3 shows woven fabric mesh speaker zone in fabric-mist gray (#C8C3BC). Body is warm ceramic white matte finish (#F2EDE8). No sharp edges, all curves continuous.

SIDE VIEW (center): Smooth organic silhouette curve like a river-worn pebble. Slightly asymmetric — front face gently convex, back face gently concave. Shows the amber light ring as a thin line at screen boundary. Fabric mesh zone visible on lower portion. Warm white body (#F2EDE8) with soft stone gray (#D4CFC9) silicone base.

TOP VIEW (right): Overall pebble shape from above — organic asymmetric oval, wider at screen end, tapering gently. Screen ellipse visible at top portion with amber ring. No buttons visible from top. Clean continuous surface.

All three views aligned horizontally, same scale, consistent proportions. Technical product design presentation style. Soft even lighting, no harsh shadows. Photorealistic industrial design render. Muji/IKEA product documentation aesthetic. No text labels needed.
negative_prompt: ElliQ two-part design, LED face, cylindrical shape, perfect sphere, sharp edges, pure black, cold white, high saturation, medical device, cyberpunk, glowing nodes, hex patterns, perspective distortion, inconsistent proportions between views, glossy metallic surfaces
